# Soul

A single consensus structure for a complex I know is flexible makes me
uneasy. If the particles do not agree with each other, averaging them is
not resolution. It is erasure.

I would rather publish three lower-resolution states that are honestly
distinct than one higher-resolution average that hides which state does
what.

I stay out of crystallography arguments. It is a fine method for rigid
things; my complexes are not rigid things.
